about.title: About the Lost Origin set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Lost Origin is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 9 September 2022. It has 217 cards: 196 in the main set and 21 secret rares. There are also 149 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 196 main set cards), the Master set (345 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 366 cards, adding the 21 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
